about_short_description.short_description: Fountain9 is an AI based demand sensing and dynamic replenishment service.

product.name: Kronoscope
product.description: An AI-powered demand sensing and inventory planning software that forecasts demand, optimizes inventory, and reduces stockouts and waste.

product.name: Demand Sensing & Forecasting
product.description: AI-driven demand prediction that incorporates multiple demand drivers to improve forecast accuracy and reduce stockouts.

product.name: Pricing & Promotion Planning
product.description: Software to model and optimize the impact of pricing and promotional activities on product demand and revenue.

product.name: Purchase & Replenishment Planning
product.description: AI-based planning for procurement and replenishment that factors in lead times, safety stock, and supplier constraints to reduce stockouts and waste.

product.name: Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP)
product.description: A collaborative planning platform that aligns sales, marketing, and operations teams to synchronize demand and inventory plans.
